fact: Leaf sums G_j, H_j; minimise G w + 1/2 (H + lambda) w^2; w* = -G/(H+lambda); obj* = -1/2 sum G^2/(H+lambda) + gamma T
Split gain formula with gamma; lambda L2 on leaf values, gamma per leaf; w* is a damped Newton step; XGBoost needs second derivatives

fact: Convexity: chord definition; tangent condition, gradient zero is global min; H >= 0; consequences: local = global, first-order stationarity suffices, minimiser set convex
Worked convexity: x^2 between -1 and 3 at t 0.5: f(1) = 1 <= 5
Convex: least squares, logistic regression, SVMs, lasso; deep nets not (permutation symmetry, average of two minima not a minimum)
CE convex in logits, Hessian diag(p) - pp^T >= 0; last layer well behaved; convex function of a linear map is convex
Strong convexity mu I <= H <= beta I; GD at eta = 1/beta shrinks gap by 1 - mu/beta = 1 - 1/kappa
Lagrange: optimise f subject to g = 0; gradients parallel; Lagrangian f - lambda g; stationary points in x and lambda; dL/dlambda = 0 is the constraint
Multiplier is a shadow price lambda = df*/dc
Worked Lagrange: max x + y on unit circle: x = y = 0.707, lambda 0.707, f* 1.414; f* = sqrt(2c), derivative 0.707 at c 1
KKT: stationarity, feasibility, mu >= 0, complementary slackness; necessary and sufficient for convex problems with Slater
where: rd-lag (Boyd 5.5.3; plus a worked inequality example)
